mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where the CPI trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where the UNRATE trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where the INDPRO trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decline for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a month and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals strong demand in the housing sector, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% over the same period, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO decline > 1%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both trigger conditions are met.
